400.description: A 400 problem: idempotency-key-required, idempotency-key-invalid, unknown-query-parameter, invalid-limit, invalid-cursor (relayed from the provider) or malformed-request (a NUL character in the query string or body, or an unreadable body).

422.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504), route-not-allowed (500), internal-error (500) and client-closed-request (499, the caller went away). Any route also answers 404 resource-not-found for a path it does not serve (or one containing NUL) and 405 method-not-allowed for a wrong method.
